== Important dependency upgrades

* Apache Neethi 3.2.2 -> 3.2.4 - https://ws.apache.org/neethi/index.html[release announcement], link:https://github.com/apache/ws-neethi/compare/neethi-3.2.2+++...+++neethi-3.2.4[changelog], fixed CVEs (see the https://ws.apache.org/neethi/security.html[Apache Neethi security advisories] for details):
** https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-66142[CVE-2026-66142] Uncontrolled recursion during policy processing
** https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-66143[CVE-2026-66143] Bypass of limits on normalized policy alternatives
** https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-66144[CVE-2026-66144] Unbounded data read when fetching remote policy references
** https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-91863[CVE-2026-91863] Stack exhaustion through policies that bypass the nesting-depth limit
** https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-91864[CVE-2026-91864] Heap exhaustion through assertions that bypass element and attribute limits
** https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-91865[CVE-2026-91865] Excessive expansion of repeated policy references during normalization
** https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-91866[CVE-2026-91866] Unbounded computation during policy intersection
** https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-91867[CVE-2026-91867] Missing total timeout when fetching remote policies

* Apache XMLSchema 2.3.2 -> 2.3.3 - https://github.com/apache/ws-xmlschema/releases/tag/xmlschema-2.3.3[release notes], link:https://github.com/apache/ws-xmlschema/compare/xmlschema-2.3.2+++...+++xmlschema-2.3.3[changelog], fixed CVEs (see the https://ws.apache.org/xmlschema/security.html[Apache XMLSchema security advisories] for details):
** https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-102495[CVE-2026-102495] Stack exhaustion when resolving deeply nested schema imports and includes
** https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-102496[CVE-2026-102496] Stack exhaustion when parsing deeply nested schema structures
** https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-102497[CVE-2026-102497] Stack exhaustion when the schema walker processes cyclic definitions (`xmlschema-walker`)

Special thanks to https://github.com/JiriOndrusek[@JiriOndrusek] for contributing the Neethi upgrade.
